ANDREI STEPIN / PRODUCT DESIGNER

Curious by default.
Precise by design.

I’m Andrei, a product designer with more than 8 years of experience building interfaces and digital products for businesses, financial services, and education around the world.

My work spans user journeys, prototypes, visual design, and full product redesigns. I aim to make products useful for the people using them and valuable for the businesses behind them.
